# In front of your code

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-blocks.mjs from scripts/blocks-meta.json. Edit that file, not this one. -->

### Middleware
- What: Code that runs on every request before it reaches a feature, such as a login check.
- Applies when: the term comes up.
- Stage: any
- Kind: concept

### Edge front door
- What: A service in front of your server that filters bad traffic and serves the app close to users.
- Applies when: the app is going live on the internet.
- Stage: go-live
- Kind: checkable
